name: Tax Increment Financing (TIF) Investment Committee Decisions - Historical

Metadata.Frequency: Data will no longer be updated

columns.name: PROJECT
columns.description: The name of the project that sought TIF funding.

columns.name: DEPARTMENT
columns.description: The Department, Company or Organization requesting the TIF Funding.

columns.name: IMPROVEMENT TYPE
columns.description: The category of development seeking TIF funds.

columns.name: ADDRESS
columns.description: The address of the project location.

columns.name: LOCATION TIF
columns.description: The TIF district(s) in which the project is located.

columns.name: LOCATION TIF NUMBER
columns.description: The TIF district(s) identifier number in which the project is located.

columns.name: FUNDING TIF
columns.description: The TIF district(s) from which the project is receiving TIF funds.

columns.name: FUNDING TIF NUMBER
columns.description: The TIF district(s) identifier number from which the project is receiving TIF funds.

columns.name: PROJECT SUMMARY
columns.description: A brief summary of the proposed project that is requesting TIF funding.

columns.name: TIF REQUEST
columns.description: The amount of TIF funding that the project is requesting.

columns.name: TOTAL PROJECT COST
columns.description: The total project cost of the project requesting TIF funding.

columns.name: PERCENTAGE OF TIF
columns.description: The share of the total project costs being covered by the requested TIF funding.

columns.name: TIC MEETING DATE
columns.description: The date of the TIF Investment Committee meeting at which the project was discussed.

columns.name: TIC DECISION
columns.description: The decision by the TIF Investment Committee members on whether to approve, deny or hold for further review TIF funding for the project.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: The location of the ADDRESS column, geocoded to a format that allows for mapping and other geographic analysis.
